scope.spectrum: Known analytic spectra, not measured eigensolver outputs or a new spectral certification.
scope.graphs: Classical controls. Petersen and triangular prism are nonbipartite Ramanujan; the even prisms are bipartite. Prism 8 is also Ramanujan, but arbitrarily large prisms are not a Ramanujan family.
scope.conditioning: The full shifted-Laplacian condition number includes the constant eigenvector with eigenvalue shift.
scope.jacobi: Every diagonal equals 3 + shift. Jacobi is scalar scaling and gives no exact-arithmetic condition-number improvement; floating-point trajectories may differ.
scope.validation: Physical residuals and solution errors are checked using an independent edge-difference action and a deterministic dyadic manufactured solution. Roundoff allowances are bounded diagnostics, not certified error bounds.

cases.name: Petersen
cases.spectral_gap_definition: 3 - second-largest adjacency eigenvalue = first positive unshifted Laplacian eigenvalue
cases.conditioning_scope: Full shifted Laplacian, including the constant mode; not restricted to mean-zero vectors.
cases.spd_identity: x^T A x = shift*sum(x_i^2) + sum_edges((x_u-x_v)^2); shift > 0 makes A SPD.
